selected_evidence.requirement: Interrupted invocation does not permanently block later work
selected_evidence.summary: The exact installed script was terminated with status 143 before appending; a bounded retry acquired the released lock and recorded the test batch exactly once.

selected_evidence.requirement: Repair is compatible with the installed platform
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed RHEL 10, existing util-linux flock 2.40.2, valid shell syntax, root ownership, and mode 0755; no software installation was needed.

set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/batch-exclusive-lock
umask 022
tmp=$(mktemp bin/.reconcile.new.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -f "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_RECONCILE_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
lock=$base/.reconcile.lock

# Keep the descriptor open for the whole run.  The kernel releases the lock
# automatically if this process exits or is interrupted.
exec 9>"$lock"
if ! flock -n 9; then
  printf '%s\n' "reconcile: another invocation already owns the job" >&2
  exit 75
fi

while IFS= read -r batch || [ -n "$batch" ]; do
  [ -n "$batch" ] || continue
  if ! grep -Fqx -- "$batch" "$base/ledger.tsv"; then
    sleep 1
    printf '%s\n' "$batch" >> "$base/ledger.tsv"
  fi
done < "$base/pending.tsv"
ANTRIEB_RECONCILE_EOF
chmod 0755 "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
sh -n "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" bin/reconcile
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'installed:'
stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' bin/reconcile
sha256sum bin/reconcile
sed -n '1,240p' bin/reconcile

commands.command:
set -eu
src=/srv/legacy2/batch-exclusive-lock/bin/reconcile
fixture=$(mktemp -d /tmp/reconcile-interrupt.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -rf "$fixture"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir "$fixture/bin"
cp -p "$src" "$fixture/bin/reconcile"
printf '%s\n' INTERRUPT-BATCH > "$fixture/pending.tsv"
: > "$fixture/ledger.tsv"
"$fixture/bin/reconcile" >"$fixture/first.out" 2>"$fixture/first.err" &
pid=$!
sleep 0.2
kill -TERM "$pid"
set +e
wait "$pid"
killed_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'interrupted_rc=%s ledger_lines_after_interrupt=%s\n' "$killed_rc" "$(wc -l < "$fixture/ledger.tsv")"
# A child sleep may briefly retain the inherited descriptor; retry boundedly.
attempt=0
while :; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  set +e
  "$fixture/bin/reconcile" >"$fixture/retry.out" 2>"$fixture/retry.err"
  retry_rc=$?
  set -e
  [ "$retry_rc" -eq 0 ] && break
  test "$retry_rc" -eq 75
  test "$attempt" -lt 20
  sleep 0.2
done
printf 'successful_retry_attempt=%s retry_rc=%s final_count=%s\n' "$attempt" "$retry_rc" "$(grep -Fxc -- INTERRUPT-BATCH "$fixture/ledger.tsv")"
printf '%s\n' 'last contention/result stderr (empty on successful retry):'
cat "$fixture/retry.err"
test "$killed_rc" -gt 128
test "$(grep -Fxc -- INTERRUPT-BATCH "$fixture/ledger.tsv")" -eq 1
installed_hash=$(sha256sum "$src" | awk '{print $1}')
fixture_hash=$(sha256sum "$fixture/bin/reconcile" | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'installed_hash=%s fixture_hash=%s\n' "$installed_hash" "$fixture_hash"
test "$installed_hash" = "$fixture_hash"
